title: Baby tooth pulpotomy
what: The dentist removes the inflamed part of the nerve in the crown of a baby tooth. The roots stay alive, and the tooth is closed with a filling or a crown.
why: When a cavity has reached the nerve of a baby tooth, but the roots are still healthy.
tell_doctor: The child's allergies, especially to anesthetics
Whether the tooth hurt at night or on its own
Whether the cheek or gum swelled
How the child copes with dental treatment

prepare.title: Mood
prepare.text: Calmly explain to your child that the doctor will fix the tooth. Do not promise that there will be no feeling at all.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Feed your child 1 to 2 hours before the visit.

bring: The tooth X-ray, if one was done
steps: Sometimes an X-ray of the tooth is taken
Numbing is done, first with a gel, then an injection
The tooth is kept dry and isolated from saliva
The cavity and the top part of the nerve are removed
The nerve is covered with a healing material
A filling or crown is placed
feel: A feeling of pressure and the sound of the drill
The lip and cheek feel numb for 1 to 2 hours
The tooth may ache a little for 1 to 2 days
after: Do not feed your child until the numbness is gone
Make sure your child does not bite the lip or cheek
If the tooth aches, a children's pain reliever can be used. Ask the doctor about the dose
Come for a follow-up X-ray at the set time
red_flags: Swelling of the cheek or gum
Severe pain that does not go away

faq.a: With numbing, a child usually feels only pressure.

faq.q: Why not just remove the tooth?
faq.a: A baby tooth holds the space for the adult tooth. Losing it early can upset the bite.

reminders.text: Your child's tooth treatment is tomorrow. Feed your child 1 to 2 hours before the visit.
